title: The Latest Crier for Sep 26, 2026
items:
Intramural Flag Football Sign-Ups EXTENDED

Intramural Flag Football sign-ups have been extended! If you missed the original deadline, you still have time to get a team together and sign up. The new deadline will be September 27. 
Plus, Pickleball and Sand Volleyball sign-ups are now open! Make sure to get your teams together and sign up for those! 

Use our Linktree to take you to our hub for sign-ups: https://linktr.ee/centralcollegeim

KIN & SC first-year advising

Join us on Academic Connections Day for an introduction to Kinesiology and Strength and Conditioning major planning. We will walk through the general sequencing within the major, and likely have time to discuss specific considerations for your plan to graduation. Please note: This is best suited for first-year students. 
Location: HJHC 104 

Time: 11 am 

Bring: your computer/access to Self-Service

Environmental and Sustainabiity Studies informational session

Interested in the environment? Sustainability? Consider becoming an environmental studies major! We'll hold an informational session at 3 pm in VSC 180

Discipleship Program: looking for mentorship in your faith?!

Join the Discipleship program: grow in your faith, build relationship with someone a little older & wiser in the community, someone to pray with, study the Bible, life chat over coffee, or even dinner with their family. If this sounds fun to you, then consider signing up for a menor/discipler. Email laflinh@central.edu to be paired! It is a life-changing experience!

Academic Connections Day Service Project - Central College Garden

The Central College Garden is looking for volunteers on Academic Connections Day! We will be removing plants, spreading mulch, and cleaning out the compost bins. Spend the afternoon outside working in an important campus community space! Please bring water and wear long pants and closed shoes. Work gloves are available at the garden if you don't have your own pair to bring. 
Morning Project: 9-11am 

Afternoon Project: 1-3pm 

To sign up, please contact Mary Robertson (morning project) or Valerie Billing (afternoon project).

Need an Academic Advisor?

Are you a first- or second-year student interested in majoring in economics, accounting, or business management but don’t yet have an academic advisor in one of these areas? Stop by one of BCOMM’s group advising sessions on Academic Connections Day (9/30) ! 10 a.m. — Weller 101 
2 p.m. — Weller 101 

Come learn more about these majors, ask questions, and connect with an advisor who can help you plan your next steps. We’d love to see you there!

Tuesday, October 13 | 11am-1pm | Graham Conference Center | 20 Employers so far Need a resume review? Upload to Handshake and one of the CR & EL Team will review.Register in advance & Check In day of for a chance to win a Career Readiness Bundle.Go to:central.joinhandshake.com to see the employers who are coming and to register.

Cooking with Spanish Club!

We’ll learn how to make a few traditional dishes, try something new, and enjoy some good food together. No Spanish experience is needed, but we’ll also learn some Spanish words and phrases along the way! 

When: October 4, 6–8 PM 

Where: Garden Cottage 

Spots are limited, so make sure to sign up! 

Sign Up Here 

Come cook with us! ¡Nos vemos! 🍴🇳🇮

St. Mary's Catholic Church FREE shuttle bus to Sunday Mass

The free shuttle bus to St. Mary's Catholic Church for Mass will run this Sunday 9/27/26. Pick-up will be on the west side of Central Market from 10:10 am to 10:15 am and at Independence and 3rd (4-way stop) from 10:16 am to 10:18 am. 
Pick-up times are carefully followed. Return drop-off will be at Central Market. No reservations are required. 

If you would like a weekly email with confirmation that the shuttle bus services will be provided that Sunday please email fullerj@central.edu

Fellowship of Christian Athletes (FCA) - NEXT WEEK!

Kick off Homecoming Week by joining FCA on the football field for Fields of Faith next Tuesday, 9/29 , at 8pm ! There will be fun games and a great message from JR Sumrall, the FCA football team chaplain at Iowa State University. We hope to see you there! 
We will be back in the BMW rooms for FCA the following week on October 6th at 8pm . 

- FCA Leadership Team

Common Ground Friendship Bracelet Making

Common Ground will be hosting a LNC on September 25th from 7:30-9:30 pm in the BMW rooms. There will be materials for making bracelets, earings, and keychains as well as a caramel apple bar and other snacks.

Interested in Chemistry or Biochemistry?

The chemistry and biochemistry faculty will be discussing careers, research opportunities, and how to navigate the majors for industry, graduate school, and healthcare. If you are interested in major or minoring in these fields, please join us! 
When: 10 am Wednesday, September 30th 

Where: VSC 269

From the Frontline of Ukraine: Howard Buffett to Speak at Central

Central College welcomes Howard Buffett, philanthropist and CEO of the Howard G. Buffett Foundation, back to campus for a conversation with Harry Smith, award-winning journalist, storyteller and 1973 Central graduate. 
The conversation will be held at noon, Wednesday, Sept. 30, Van Emmerik Studio, Maytag Student Center. 

Buffett has documented this work in Ukraine in his book, “Courage of a Nation: Three Years of War.” In it, Buffett recounts his experiences through his own words and photography. 

On Central’s campus, Buffett will share what he’s learned from the people of Ukraine, including those on the frontlines of the war, and those who are still striving for freedom in their day to day lives, despite being under Russian occupation.
